svg.aria-label: Two continuous cosine waves of 2 Hz and 6 Hz producing the same sample points at eight samples per second
svg.title: Two continuous cosine waves of 2 Hz and 6 Hz producing the same sample points at eight samples per second

g.text: Cosine waves at 2 Hz and 6 Hz sampled 8 times per second
Same sampled points; different continuous waveforms. Sampling alone cannot distinguish these signals.
